svg.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Azure Fleet Security and Patch Remediation hybrid and multicloud architecture
svg.desc: Architecture diagram showing Azure SRE Agent gathering read-only evidence from Azure management services, Azure Arc federating Azure, on-premises, AWS, and GCP machines in production, pre-production, and development environments, an owner approving targeted remediation, Azure Update Manager applying approved guest updates, and the agent publishing dashboard evidence.
svg.text: Hybrid and multicloud architecture: evidence, approval, Arc federation, and guest patch verification
Centralized evidence, policy, orchestration, and Arc-connected machine management
Static or live reporting depends on
The same assessment and approval model can be scoped by cloud and environment when machines are Arc-enabled.
Policies, maintenance windows, and approvals remain explicit per environment.
Arc connection, inventory, and guest telemetry
Azure Arc extends the Azure control plane to connected machines; each cloud and environment remains independently scoped and approved.
